dedupe_keys.name: opamss geoportal thematic maps of the san salvador metropolitan area

description: The OPAMSS geoportal is the map site of the planning office of the San Salvador metropolitan area in El Salvador. The page read on 2026-09-28 organises thematic maps in three groups: normative maps from the regulation of the metropolitan development and land-use law and the annexes of the 2026 metropolitan plan; research maps produced by OPAMSS on urban, environmental and socioeconomic topics, including a hydrogeological map, critical hydraulic zones, a tree inventory, a runoff curve number map, crime locations, land value trends, 2014 land use and road lanes by direction; and collaborative maps from partners, with a user guide. Coverage is the San Salvador metropolitan area and neighbouring municipalities. Access is free for viewing; no licence or download format is stated. Caveats: layers appear as web maps and may not be downloadable, and some themes are dated (land use 2014). It supports flood and drainage hazard exposure studies, as the curve number and critical hydraulic zone maps feed runoff models, and urban planning scenarios for the capital region. No related San Salvador record is catalogued; national hazard maps complement it.
